race.comment: BOMB LUCA (1) missed the frame two back but wound up strongly last time, finishing on late when third (22.06) in a Grade 5 at this track. One of the contenders. ASHY BEAR (3) showed little early speed at her last couple, the latest finishing fourth (22.09) in a Mix 5 at this track. Form here sound including nine wins. Great chance to atone. SMOKING ACE (2) finds it hard to win. Better run when finding the frame last time though, finishing third (22.31) at this track. Hard to beat again. VERRUCKT (4) hasn't been far away, finishing in the money twice in a row including last time in a Mix 5 at this track over 380m.
